reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and routes every former d.isWeekend check through one new shared isNonWorkingDay predicate rather than adding holiday checks inline.

duplication.why: The holiday test itself is written once; what is repeated is the per-site enlargement of occurrence windows (count*2+14+2h, 7+h, 3+h) in three places that already each carried their own daily-skip branch.

placement.why: The predicate and the move rule live in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend rule; server call sites only pass the config's holidays.

scope.why: Only holiday plumbing, the type field and a release note; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: What counts as a non-working day is in one predicate, but the daily-skip decision and the look-ahead/margin bounds remain duplicated across getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, now with three different ad hoc holiday adjustments.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend checks in schedules/app.ts and shared/schedules.ts were switched to isNonWorkingDay / getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays; none remain on d.isWeekend directly.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic copied; the repeated window arithmetic is visible per site and pre-existing in structure.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts decides weekend-or-holiday for both moving (getDateWithSkippedWeekend) and daily skipping (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange); the window sizes still have to be adjusted at each site.
